title.zh: Antigravity 桌面端支持通过 SSH 连接远程服务器
title.en: Antigravity desktop can connect to remote servers over SSH

summary.zh: Antigravity 官方宣布，桌面端已经能通过 SSH 连接远程服务器，并提供了文档。这是给桌面交互增加远程入口，与同日 Codex CLI 把非交互任务接到已有 app server 不是同一件事。
summary.en: Antigravity officially announced that the desktop app can already connect to remote servers over SSH, and published documentation. This adds a remote entry point for desktop interaction. It is not the same as Codex CLI attaching non-interactive tasks to an existing app server on the same day.

brief.zh: Antigravity 官方宣布桌面端已能通过 SSH 连接远程服务器，并提供了文档。
brief.en: Antigravity announced that its desktop app can connect to remote servers over SSH, and published documentation.

why.zh: 这是 Antigravity 桌面工作流的远程入口，应与 Codex 的远程 exec 分开记录。
why.en: This is a remote entry point for the Antigravity desktop workflow, and should be recorded separately from Codex remote exec.
